plugins.name: hilbana
plugins.description: Everything Hilbana in one install: persistent agent memory (an engram replacement, with hooks that load context and save summaries automatically) + the human+agent workflow framework (pull queue, the /hilbana-plan orchestrator, and the cycle prompts claim_next/finish/review served by the MCP itself) + Hilbana's MCP server auto-registered. Commands and skills are written in Spanish.
